definition: a woman who engages in promiscuous sexual activity for pay; a whore; a harlot; a prostitute.
example_en: Prostitute women lived in that street.

definition: in a small degree; to a slight extent; not much; a little.
example_en: She added a little salt to the cooking.

definition: the dramatic exhibition of an invasion or siege.
example: ಶತ್ರು ಸೈನ್ಯದ ಡಿಮ ಜನರಲ್ಲಿ ಭಯ ಹುಟ್ಟಿಸಿತು.
example_en: The dramatic exhibition of the enemy army's siege instilled fear in the people.

definition: to brush and clean the teeth.
example_en: One should brush and clean the teeth every morning after waking up.

definition: a man who kills another person or an animal unlawfully and premeditatedly; a killer; a murderer.
example_en: The police arrested the murderer.

definition: the seed of flax; linseed.
example_en: The farmers sowed linseed along the field bund.

definition: fine and intricate art-work.
example: ಆ ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನದ ಗೋಡೆಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಸುಂದರ ಕಲಾಕುಸುರು ಕಾಣುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: Beautiful, intricate art-work can be seen on the walls of that temple.

definition: abiding; staying.
example_en: He is a person who is abiding by his stance.

definition: official records collectively.
example_en: They sent that record to the office.

definition: to come running.
example_en: The children came running to watch the game.

definition: the act or process of buying or selling.
example_en: The buying and selling of land is going on in this village.

definition: a kind of plantain.
example: ಅಂಗಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕಲುವಾೞೆ ಹಣ್ಣುಗಳು ರಾಶಿ ರಾಶಿಯಾಗಿ ಇದ್ದವು.
example_en: The kaluvale plantain fruits were piled up in heaps in the shop.

definition: a giving of something free of cost.
example_en: They distributed free food at the temple.

definition: that which is necessary for making something whole, complete, perfect, etc.; a defect; deficiency.
example: ಈ ಕೆಲಸದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಸಣ್ಣ ಐಬು ಉಳಿದಿದೆ.
example_en: A small defect remains in this work.

definition: the action of a clown, jester.
example_en: The children laughed seeing his clownish antics.

definition: to stretch one's body or a limb.
example_en: Tired, she sat in the chair and stretched her body.

definition: wheresoever.
example_en: Wheresoever one goes, he will be found.

definition: the sea-water adjoining the shore.
example_en: The sea-water near the shore rocked the boats.

definition: a thin, bare plant not having leaves, flowers, etc.
example_en: A bare leafless plant stood alone on the hill.

definition: eyeglasses with special lenses, usu. tinted, to protect the eyes from the suṇs glare; sunglasses.
example_en: He wore sunglasses to protect himself from the sun's glare.

definition: a piece of cloth having different colours in spots, stripes; a part-coloured cloth.
example_en: She wore a part-coloured cloth and went to the festival.

definition: a royal house.
example_en: The king's royal house shone in the middle of the city.

definition: to lay or spread (something) for drying.
example_en: Grandmother spread the papads on the roof to dry.

definition: a figure painted by women on their bodies with different dyes.
example: ಹಬ್ಬದ ದಿನ ಹೆಂಗಸರು ಕೈಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಮಕರಿ ಬಿಡಿಸಿಕೊಂಡರು.
example_en: On the festival day, the women had makari designs drawn on their hands.

definition: any of the four equal parts of something; a quarter.
example_en: They divided the circle into four quarters.

definition: a cudgel held in the hand.
example_en: He held the cudgel in his hand and faced the opponent.

definition: the plant Cleome viscosa of Capparaceae family.
example_en: The wild mustard plant had grown along the field bund.

definition: the topsy-turvy condition.
example_en: The boat turned topsy-turvy.

definition: the quality, duty etc. of a nurse, wet nurse, etc.
example_en: She practised the duty of a nurse with devotion.

definition: suddenly; all of a sudden.
example_en: The rain started suddenly.

definition: to be or get, defeated.
example_en: That king was defeated in the war.

definition: to deliberately ignore (injustice, wrong, etc.).
example_en: The officer saw the corruption yet deliberately ignored it.

definition: a man of social importance.
example_en: Everyone respected the important man of the village.

definition: name of the capital city of Karnāṭaka State, in Southern India.
example_en: Bengaluru is the capital city of Karnataka.

definition: a charming, fascinating woman.
example_en: Everyone liked the charming woman's talk.

definition: a going back on one's promise; a disapointing; deception.
example: ಅವನ ವಿಪ್ರಲಂಭ ಅವಳಿಗೆ ತುಂಬಾ ನೋವು ಕೊಟ್ಟಿತು.
example_en: His broken promise caused her great pain.

definition: the quality of an iniquitous, unjust, wicked fellow.
example_en: Because of his rascally nature, the villagers all kept away from him.

definition: to consider; to take into consideration.
example_en: We took his suggestion into consideration.

definition: (a dog, wolf, etc.) to utter the characteristic long, loud, wailing cry; to howl.
example_en: The wolf howled during the rainy season.

definition: a goldsmith.
example_en: That goldsmith crafted gold ornaments.

definition: the central portion on the top of the human head; the crown of the head.
example_en: The grandmother gently stroked the baby's crown.

definition: a man excellent in a particular class or field of action.
example: ಸಂಗೀತದಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನೊಬ್ಬ ಚಟ್ಟ ಎಂದು ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಒಪ್ಪುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: Everyone agrees that he is an excellent man in music.

definition: to spring, get or jump up or rush in over-enthusiasm or fit of frenzy.
example: ಸಂತೋಷದ ಭರದಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನು ಉರ್ವೇೞ್ದು ಮುಂದೆ ಓಡಿದ.
example_en: In a fit of excitement, he sprang up and ran forward.

definition: to long for; to crave; to desire.
example_en: He craved greatly to go to his native village.

definition: to pay the wages, compensation for a person's labour.
example_en: The owner paid the wages to the labourer.

definition: to press hard or closely; exert pressure on, esp. from two or more sides; to compress.
example_en: He compressed the bag by pressing it hard.

definition: a going or coming closer or drawing near; an approach.
example: ಅತಿಥಿಗಳ ಉಪಾಯನ ನೋಡಿ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಎದ್ದು ನಿಂತರು.
example_en: Seeing the guests' approach, everyone stood up.

definition: to confine within bounds; to set a limit to; to restrict; to limit.
example: ಸರ್ಕಾರ ಖರ್ಚನ್ನು ಪರಿಮಿತಿಗೊಳಿಸಲು ಹೊಸ ನಿಯಮ ತಂದಿತು.
example_en: The government brought a new rule to restrict expenditure.

definition: a high-way.
example_en: This high-way connects the city with the border.

definition: the internal space or recess formed by the meeting of two sides, esp. of a room; a corner.
example_en: The cat sat hidden in that corner.

definition: (hist.) an amount of seven aṇas.
example: ಆ ಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಹಣವಡ ಒಂದು ದೊಡ್ಡ ಮೊತ್ತವಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: In those days, a hanavada was a large sum of money.

definition: serving no purpose; useless.
example_en: Do not throw the useless paper all over the place.

definition: the act or an instance of bringing several things, people, etc. together.
example_en: The festival succeeded because of the gathering together of the townspeople.

definition: a going forward or onward; progression.
example: ಸೈನಿಕರ ಪ್ರತಿಕ್ರಮಣ ಶತ್ರುಗಳ ನೆಲದ ಕಡೆಗೆ ಸಾಗಿತು.
example_en: The soldiers' advance proceeded towards the enemy's land.

definition: the plant Canna indica of Cannaceae family.
example_en: The canna plant grows abundantly during the rainy season.

definition: a bird (in gen.).
example: ಬೆಳಗಿನ ಜಾವ ಮರದ ಮೇಲೆ ಒಂದು ವಿಹಂಗಮ ಕುಳಿತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A bird was sitting on the tree in the early morning.

definition: a small southern constellation near Virgo; the Crow; the Corvus.
example_en: The Corvus constellation appears near Virgo.

definition: that act of doing or tendency to do, something which is not in conformity with the law, social or moral standard.
example_en: The villagers grew weary of his tendency to do unlawful things.

definition: a flower-arrow of Manmatha; the Love-God.
example_en: Poets have written about Manmatha's flower-arrow.

definition: the presiding goddess of a town.
example_en: On the festival day they offered flowers to the town goddess.

definition: a once-supposed very early form of a man represented by parts of skull found at Piltdown, Sussex, which later proved to be of an ape; eo-anthropus.
example_en: Scientists had been mistaken about the eo-anthropus.

definition: a narrow or constrained place.
example_en: The narrow space between the houses was very small.

definition: to turn upside down; to dip (oneself) from a higher position down or downward.
example_en: The boys played by diving upside down into the pond.

definition: an installation of an idol in the prescribed religious manner.
example_en: The priests performed the installation of the idol in the temple.

definition: the basil plant Ocimum basilicum of Lamiaceae family; sweet basil.
example_en: Grandmother planted a sweet basil plant in the pot.

definition: (hist.) a British gold coin valued at 20 shillings or one pound sterling; a sovereign.
example: ಅವನ ಬಳಿ ಎರಡು ಹಳೆಯ ಸವರನ್ ನಾಣ್ಯಗಳಿದ್ದವು.
example_en: He had two old sovereign coins with him.

definition: to become complicated and hence require more effort to deal with; to become difficult to solve, untangle or analyse.
example_en: This problem became more complicated.

definition: not orderly; unsystematic; disorderly.
example_en: The work of that department is being conducted in a disorderly manner.

definition: a large stone either detached or not from the mass; a rock.
example_en: There was a large rock on that hill.

definition: the chief of an army.
example_en: The army chief sent troops to defend the border.

definition: an earnest attempt or effort; an endeavour.
example: ಗುರಿ ಸಾಧಿಸಲು ಅವನು ನಿರಂತರ ಉದ್ಯೋಗ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: He made a constant earnest effort to achieve his goal.

definition: a hole bored, drilled into something.
example_en: A small bored hole was seen in the door.

definition: to give way to anxiety or unease; to allow one's mind to dwell on difficulty or troubles; to worry.
example_en: The mother worried about her son's health.

definition: to swear an oath; to utter an execration; to curse.
example_en: In anger, he cursed his enemy.

definition: cleaned, purified well.
example: ಆ ಎಣ್ಣೆ ಶುದ್ಧೀಕರಿಸಿ ಪರಿಪೂತವಾಗಿ ಮಾರಾಟಕ್ಕೆ ಬಂದಿತು.
example_en: That oil, thoroughly purified, came out for sale.

definition: to give trouble to; to annoy; to vex.
example_en: The neighbours annoy us every day.

definition: the act of shaping wood, metal rod, ivory, etc. into required shape by turning it rapidly on a lathe against the edge of a cutting or abrading tool.
example: ಬಡಗಿ ಕಡಚಲಿನಿಂದ ಮರದ ತುಂಡಿಗೆ ದುಂಡಾದ ಆಕಾರ ಕೊಟ್ಟನು.
example_en: The carpenter gave a round shape to the piece of wood by turning it on the lathe.

definition: a blessing; benediction.
example_en: The teacher pronounced a blessing upon the disciple.

definition: he who causes something fall down; a feller.
example: ಆ ಬೀಳುಗ ಮರಗಳನ್ನು ಕಡಿದು ಕೆಳಗೆ ಉರುಳಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The feller cut down the trees and toppled them to the ground.

definition: an authority delegated by a person to another to act for the former.
example_en: A power of attorney letter was given to the lawyer.

definition: an act of arranging or preparing; the state of being arranged or prepared; arrangement; preparation.
example_en: The arrangement needed for the wedding has already been completed.

definition: to be related, connected to.
example_en: These two matters are related to each other.

definition: the act or process of cleaning, cleansing, removing the adulterants.
example_en: One must drink water only after it is purified.

definition: not sure of; not definite; uncertain.
example: ಅವನ ಆಗಮನದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಮೋಗಮ್ ಮಾಹಿತಿ ಮಾತ್ರ ಸಿಕ್ಕಿತು.
example_en: Only uncertain information about his arrival was received.

definition: a row - a) a number of people or things arranged so as to form a line, esp. a straight line; b) any of a series of such horizontal lines in parallel, as of seats in a theater or airplane, corn in a field, etc.; c) any of a series of layers, strata, one above the other, (as of a segment of a wall of a particular height).
example_en: The children stood in a line, in a single row.

definition: a very sharp point or edge.
example: ಆ ಕತ್ತಿಯ ಕಡುಮೊನೆ ಬಟ್ಟೆಯನ್ನು ಸುಲಭವಾಗಿ ಕತ್ತರಿಸಿತು.
example_en: The very sharp edge of that knife cut the cloth easily.

definition: an act of surrounding, encircling.
example_en: The soldiers completed the surrounding of the fort.

definition: a man as related to another's child whom he brings up, rears as his own; a forster-father.
example_en: That man became a foster-father to the orphan child.

definition: the descriptive science dealing with the surface of the earth, its division into continents and countries, and the climate, plants, animals, natural resources, inhabitants, and industries of the various divisions; geography.
example_en: Children are taught geography at school.

definition: not recurring; not moving in a cyclic manner.
example_en: That process, being non-recurring, happened only once.

definition: a light sleep.
example: ಪ್ರಯಾಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಕೇವಲ ನಾಯಿನಿದ್ದೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ಸಿಕ್ಕಿತು.
example_en: During the journey, he got only a light sleep.

definition: (geol.) the first geologic period in the Paleozoic Era, marked by a profusion of marine animals, esp. trilobites and brachiopods; the Cambrian era.
example_en: In the Cambrian era, many creatures lived in the sea.

definition: a small inflamed elevation of the skin; a pustule or papule; a pimple.
example_en: A pimple appeared on her face.

definition: the body of a human being.
example: ಮಾನವನ ವಪು ಪಂಚಭೂತಗಳಿಂದ ಆಗಿದೆ ಎಂದು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: They say the human body is made of the five elements.

definition: the state of being distressed; accute mental suffering.
example: ಆ ಸುದ್ದಿ ಕೇಳಿ ಅವಳಿಗೆ ಬಗೆಯೞಲ್ ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: On hearing that news, she experienced deep mental distress.

definition: an examination in which the examiner examines the examinee in person; oral examination.
example_en: The interviewers conducted an oral examination of the candidate.

definition: a praying; supplication.
example_en: The devotees offered supplication to god.

definition: the large-sized, evergreen tree Palaquium ellipticum ( = Dichopsis elliptica) of Sapotaceae family.
example_en: The leaves of the Palaquium ellipticum tree are thick.

definition: a resonating body or device, as for increasing sonority or for analysing sound; a resonator.
example_en: The musicians used the box as a resonator.

definition: proper; right; appropriate; fitting; seemly.
example_en: This is a fitting answer for this occasion.

definition: a passageway, as through a mountain; a tunnel.
example_en: A tunnel passes through the hill.

definition: the mature female of a bovine animal, of the genus Bos; a cow.
example: ಆ ಧೇನು ಪ್ರತಿದಿನ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಹಾಲು ಕೊಡುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: That cow gives more milk every day.

definition: a disease of the skin characterised by black, red and white spots.
example: ಆ ಮಗುವಿನ ಚರ್ಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಂಗು ರೋಗ ಕಂಡುಬಂದಿತು.
example_en: The spotted skin disease called bangu was found on that child's skin.

definition: the plant Amorphophallus campanulatum ( = Arum Campanulatum) of Araceae family.
example_en: They roasted the ಖೈಸೂರಣ tuber in the kitchen.

definition: the first section of the small intestine, between the stomach and the jejunum; duodenum.
example_en: The digested food goes from the stomach into the duodenum.

definition: that which is to be done or restrained from doing, as per a contract entered between two or more parties.
example_en: Both parties fulfilled the obligation as per the contract.

definition: the flour of bengal gram.
example_en: She made pakoras using bengal gram flour.

definition: not bent; straight.
example_en: That bamboo pole stood unbent and straight.

definition: a ceasing or stopping for ever; the end; cessation.
example: ಅವರ ಸ್ನೇಹದ ಪರ್ಯವಸಾನ ಬಹಳ ದುಃಖದಿಂದ ಆಯಿತು.
example_en: The end of their friendship came about very sadly.

definition: to become smaller; to shrink or contract (oneself).
example_en: The leaf dried up in the sun and shrank.

definition: the universe created by Brahma.
example_en: The universe created by Brahma is described in the puranas.

definition: to enclose from all sides; to encircle.
example_en: The farmer enclosed the field with a fence.

definition: a hereditary estate.
example_en: That land was his ancestors' hereditary estate.

definition: a complete metaphor.
example_en: The poet has used a complete metaphor in that verse.

definition: a man who is armed with or uses a spear; a spearman.
example_en: The spearman held his spear and walked forward.

definition: a singing of songs in chorus.
example_en: The children sang songs in chorus at the festival.

definition: the quality or state of being magnanimous; generosity; magnanimity; nobility.
example_en: Everyone admires his generosity.

definition: inhibition - a) a restraining action of the unconscious will; b) the blocking of a mental or psychophysical process by another set up at the same time by the same stimulus; c) stoppage, complete or partial, of a physical process by some nervous influence.
example_en: Fear caused an inhibition in his thinking.

definition: drawing in of the stomach; shrinking.
example_en: His stomach felt a shrinking sensation from hunger.

definition: the land that is situated below the level of a water tank (i.e. fed by the tank).
example_en: Paddy grows well in the land fed by the tank.

definition: the amount to be paid by an insurance company to an insured, who surrenders his policy; surrender value.
example_en: When the policy was surrendered, the surrender value was paid.

definition: a kind of spicy eatable made by frying in oil, the pasta pressed into long, thin, intertwined strings.
example_en: Hot mucchore is available to eat in the shop.

definition: to go back; to retreat.
example_en: Out of fear, the horse retreated.

definition: a region or place where a class of or species of animals, a group of people naturally live or originated from.
example: ಈ ಪ್ರದೇಶ ಆನೆಗಳ ನೆಲವೀಡು ಎಂದು ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧವಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: This region is famous as the native habitat of elephants.

definition: high or excess speed or velocity.
example_en: The rocket shot into the sky with tremendous speed.

definition: to cause to or help cross over or reach the other end; to enable to surmount or endure a difficulty.
example: ಗುರುಗಳು ನಮ್ಮನ್ನು ಕಷ್ಟದ ಕಾಲವನ್ನು ಕಡೆಹಾಸಲು ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: The teacher helped us to endure and get through the difficult time.

definition: the act or an instance of keeping, laying something very close.
example: ಅವನು ಹಳೆಯ ವಸ್ತುಗಳ ಉಪನ್ಯಾಸ ಮಾಡಿ ಜೋಪಾನವಾಗಿಟ್ಟನು.
example_en: He kept the old things laid close and carefully preserved.

definition: a year in which comparatively more (land) revenue is received by the state exchequer.
example: ಬೆಳೆ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಬಂದ ಕಾರಣ ಚಡ್‍ಸಾಲ್ ಆಯಿತು.
example_en: Because the harvest was good, it turned into a year of high revenue.

definition: the pure, chaste Kannaḍa language.
example_en: He used pure Kannada words in his speech.

definition: a tying or being tied with a rope, string, shackles.
example_en: The thief's binding with rope was tied tightly.

definition: a woman who has no trust or faith (in).
example_en: Being a woman without faith, she did not believe her husband's words.

definition: a drug, gas, etc. used to produce anaesthesia, as before surgery; an anaesthetic.
example_en: Before the surgery, the doctors gave an anaesthetic.

definition: anything that is related to the nose.
example_en: The doctor gave medicine related to the nose.

definition: crosswise and lengthwise.
example: ಬಟ್ಟೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಅವರಸಚೌರಸ ಕಡ್ಡಿಗಳನ್ನು ಇಟ್ಟು ಅಳತೆ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: He laid sticks crosswise and lengthwise on the cloth and measured it.

definition: a false idea or conception; belief or opinion not in accord with the facts; illusion.
example_en: That is merely an illusion, not the truth.

definition: (dial.) a vine.
example_en: The kānakallaṭe vine had spread and grown at the edge of the forest.

definition: any machine that uses energy to develop mechanical power; esp., a machine for transmitting motion to some other machine; an engine.
example_en: A new engine was installed in the factory.

definition: grey-haired.
example_en: His hair had turned grey-haired and white.

definition: a manner; a type; a kind.
example_en: Clothes of this kind are in great demand.

definition: a man affected with scabies or any other itch-disease.
example_en: The man afflicted with scabies was suffering from the skin disease.

definition: a brief, but to the point, talk.
example_en: Everyone understood the teacher's brief, to-the-point talk.

definition: relating to the pyre.
example_en: The priests explained about the rites relating to the pyre.

definition: a fowl that frequents water; water-fowl.
example_en: A water-fowl was swimming in the pond.

definition: the state of having a physical body.
example_en: Every living being has a physical body.

definition: the fact or state of being associated or joined with; association.
example_en: The association between the two was very strong.

definition: a man who is defeated.
example: ಯುದ್ಧದಲ್ಲಿ ಸೋತ ಪರಿಭೂತ ರಾಜ ಕ್ಷಮೆ ಕೇಳಿದನು.
example_en: The defeated king who lost in the war sought forgiveness.

definition: a raised patch of skin, esp. of epidermis, filled with watery matter and caused by a burn, rubbing, etc.; a blister.
example: ಹೊಸ ಚಪ್ಪಲಿ ತೊಟ್ಟದ್ದರಿಂದ ಕಾಲಿಗೆ ಪೊಕ್ಳ ಎದ್ದಿತು.
example_en: Because he wore new sandals, a blister rose on his foot.

definition: to turn (something) back.
example_en: He turned the departed cart back.

definition: a commodity or commodities bound together; a bundle.
example_en: He carried away a bundle of books.

definition: weariness and dissatisfaction resulting from inactivity or lack of interest; boredom; ennui.
example: ಮಳೆಯ ದಿನ ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಏನೂ ಕೆಲಸವಿಲ್ಲದೆ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಬೇಜಾರು ಆಯಿತು.
example_en: On the rainy day, with no work at home, he felt bored.

definition: Śiva, the enemy of Yama, the God of Death.
example_en: The devotees prayed to Shiva, the enemy of Yama, and asked for liberation.

definition: a taking of fruits only for food.
example: ಹಬ್ಬದಂದು ಫರಾಳವನ್ನು ಮಾತ್ರ ಸೇವಿಸುವ ಪದ್ಧತಿ ಇದೆ.
example_en: On the festival day, there is a custom of taking only fruit-food.

definition: suppressed, but potent anger.
example_en: His suppressed anger was hidden within silence.

definition: a thin slab or bent piece of baked clay used for roof covering; a tile.
example_en: Tiles have been used on the old house's roof.

definition: a robbing during daytime; a daylight robbery.
example_en: A daylight robbery took place in that shop yesterday.

definition: the individual soul.
example_en: The vedantins discussed the nature of the individual soul.

definition: a small circle used in writing to represent the nasal phoneme.
example_en: Do not write a small circle instead of the anusvara.

definition: the state of being swollen or enlarged; excessiveness; abundance.
example: ನದಿಯ ಉಬ್ಬರದಿಂದ ದಡದ ಮನೆಗಳಿಗೆ ನೀರು ನುಗ್ಗಿತು.
example_en: Due to the swelling of the river, water rushed into the houses on the bank.

example_en: That merchant was selling clothes of Sinhalese tradition.

definition: to become greater in size, number, intensity, etc.
example_en: The problem kept becoming greater day by day.

definition: to make a rope or ropes by intertwisting strands of fibre, leather sraps, etc.
example_en: He made a rope by intertwisting fibres.

definition: the act of blinking of eye-lids; twinkling; winking.
example_en: Her eye-blink was very gentle.

definition: a stroke; a blow.

example_en: The girl is running on the playground.

definition: to flow in stream.

definition: the climbing plant Piper betle of the Piperaceae family.
example_en: Grandfather used to chew betel leaf every day.

definition: of the colour that is characteristic of growing grass; green.
example_en: After the rain, the field shone green.

definition: the mentally or emotionally disturbed state.

definition: a loose knot.

definition: to bring into being; to create; to make or manufacture.

example_en: This factory manufactures a thousand items every month.

definition: a bird, akin to crow, resembling the pheasant; a crow-pheasant.

definition: an embossed figure or a metal plate; a raised print on a paper; an embossed ornamentation; embossment.
example_en: A beautiful embossed figure is seen on the door.

definition: as a result of this or that; for this or that reason; consequently; hence; therefore.
example_en: It rained, therefore the trip was cancelled.

definition: to kick (something) with the foot very hard as to break into peaces.
example_en: He kicked the door hard in anger, breaking it.

example_en: He struggled a great deal in life and achieved victory.

definition: spiced pasta in the form of long, very thin strings, fried in oil; a crisp light dish.

example_en: Mother served sev along with evening tea.

definition: an implying of something that has not been actually expressed; implication of something in addition or any other similar object where only one is mentioned.
example_en: That sentence carried an implied meaning.

definition: a hemispherical roof or one formed by a series of rounded arches or vaults on a round or many-sided base; a large cupola; a dome.
example_en: The mosque's dome was white in color.

definition: (dial.) any of the religious rites to be performed at the appointed hour every day.
example: ಪೂಜಾರಿ ಪ್ರತಿದಿನ ನಿಗದಿತ ಹೊತ್ತಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಅನೀಕ ನಡೆಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: The priest performs the daily religious rite at the appointed hour.

definition: to seize or take into custody by authority of the law; to arrest and imprison.
example_en: The police arrested the thief and sent him to jail.

definition: the state of being crippled; lameness.
example_en: He cannot walk because of the lameness he has had from birth.
